lines.text: Good afternoon. What can I help you with?
I'm coming in with a painful right shoulder, it's been about four weeks.
Er, six weeks, I mean, it started before my holiday.
Lift both arms up to the side for me. Painful between about 70 and 120 degrees on the right, that's a pinched tendon pattern.
I think what's going on is irritation of the rotator cuff tendon.
Don't sleep on that side for now, and hug a pillow so the arm isn't hanging forward.
Thank you, Mr Achterberg. Please make a follow up appointment at reception on your way out.
Mrs Delacroix-Hume? Do come in. I'm sorry you've been kept waiting.
Not at all. It's my hip, really, it aches when I've been sitting through a long drive.
